sections.title: New features
items: todayOS+ adds coffee action reminders: set daily coffee times and stop reminders a chosen number of hours before bed
todayOS+ adds saved water amounts for quick logging on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac

sections.title: Experience improvements
items: When sleep data suggests an earlier bedtime, see the recommended time and how much earlier it is

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Fixed saving sleep and wind-down times together, and progress ordering for skipped actions or actions past their cutoff
Improved health data updates across devices to prevent older data from overwriting newer records
Fixed missed action notifications, Apple Watch remaining on an explanation after returning to the foreground, and clipped buttons in shorter water widgets

sections.title: New features
items: Siri and Shortcuts support on iPhone and iPad: check your current action, progress and sleep plan, log water, tooth brushing, meals and showers, and adjust sleep times and action reminders

sections.title: Experience improvements
items: Keep today's existing health progress and records when changing time zones
After enabling health-related features on iPhone and iPad, authorized health data is read again so action reminders reflect changes sooner

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Fixed shower reminders disappearing unexpectedly and daylight reminders not correctly reflecting forecast changes
Improved the reliability of Apple Watch, widget and cross-device health data updates, preventing older data from replacing newer progress
Canceling edits to settings for saving data to Apple Health now discards unsaved changes

sections.title: New features
items: todayOS now supports iPad. The main screen, settings, onboarding, todayOS+ plans, and widgets are optimized for larger displays, with support for portrait, landscape, and resizable windows
todayOS+ can now show currently active weather alerts for your area on the main screen of iPhone and iPad. Tap an alert to view its full details and source
Meal times outside your awake phase are now clearly marked in settings and onboarding, with an option to move them to the nearest valid time

sections.title: Experience improvements
items: Changes to your subscription status no longer overwrite your todayOS+ preferences. Weather, sleep, stress, hydration, iCloud sync, appearance, and other settings return when you resubscribe
Improved content width, plan layouts, settings rows, and large editor sheets when using iPad in wider or resizable windows
Clarified when the “Get Daylight” action reminder will return after sunlight conditions are unsuitable

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Fixed chevrons not staying aligned to the trailing edge when longer setting names wrap
Improved stability and interface details

sections.title: Experience improvements
items: Improved main-screen restoration speed when reopening the iOS and Apple Watch apps
Updated the main screen’s action, progress, and information layout to make content more focused and consistent
Improved action-card animations and interaction feedback, with support for Reduce Motion
Improved iCloud and Mac sync reliability
Improved the accuracy of Mac usage-time calculations
Hints are no longer shown during sleep, keeping the main screen calmer
“Stand Up” reminders now resume sooner after a ride ends
If you leave onboarding and reopen the app, todayOS now keeps what you’ve completed and resumes at the next unfinished step

sections.title: Benefits of upgrading to todayOS+
items: The free version now shows app recommendation ads from Kickstart Exchange on the main screen; ad impressions and clicks are not linked to a specific user or device. See our Privacy Policy for details
todayOS+ provides an ad-free experience

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Fixed action reminder notifications sometimes appearing more than once
Fixed “Stand Up” sometimes briefly becoming a priority reminder after a widget update
Fixed completed bedtime actions sometimes being overlooked after delaying sleep
Fixed the early-bedtime settings entry still showing a lock while subscribed

sections.title: Free updates
items: Up to two actions that are suitable to start now can appear at the same time. Actions snoozed or skipped for today no longer appear
Added animations to action reminder cards for smoother entrances and exits
Countdown progress bars, such as time awake and sedentary time, now animate as time runs down
Added contextual information on iOS below Progress
Added sunrise and sunset times and countdowns
Added information when travel in a vehicle is detected and Stand Up reminders are paused
Made Reorder easier to find in Reminders & Goals
Added in-app version update notices and release notes on iOS
Added a link in iOS Settings to rate and review todayOS on the App Store
Improved the launch experience by preserving the previous state while refreshing it
Reduced repeated switching between sunlight and exercise suggestions during weather updates. Actual progress remains visible while a reminder is temporarily suppressed
Improved layouts for longer button labels and larger text sizes
Significantly reduced memory use and idle energy consumption when todayOS runs on Mac for long periods, and improved updates to todayOS+ eligibility and free action suggestions

sections.title: Improvements for todayOS+
items: Added rain and rain-ending forecasts
Added context when weather is unsuitable for sunlight or UV is elevated, with better timing when a suitable forecast is available
Improved the location permission flow during initial setup
Fixed an issue where widgets could display outdated content
Corrected text and number formatting across multiple languages
Fixed an issue where action reminder notifications could appear more than once or fail to reflect the latest settings
Improved the performance and stability of UI updates

sections.title: Improvements for todayOS+
items: Improved early bedtime suggestions to also account for recent sleep debt, naps and recovery sleep
Improved timing and duration for sunlight reminders. They now avoid unsuitable times and weather, and extend the daylight goal when sunlight is weaker
More up-to-date local weather information
Improved place name formatting to avoid overly long location names

sections.title: Free updates
items: The home screen background now matches real-world sky colours more accurately, especially around sunrise and sunset, with improved support for high-latitude locations.

Added optional travel detection to reduce ‘Stand Up’ reminders while travelling in a vehicle. It requires Background Location and uses significant location changes instead of continuous location tracking.
todayOS is officially available!
